sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory via zipfile/XML because openpyxl is not installed): 'Quality Checks' row 7 (#6) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 7 (#6, 'seed + runtime with no network'); no comment parts in the workbook
evidence: REACHABILITY. Runtime: environment/Dockerfile installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules on node:22-bookworm-slim; tests/Dockerfile installs the same versions and tests/test.sh launches the app with env -i PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT=3000/DB_PATH as uid 65534 (test.sh lines ~97-111, restart helper ~160-167), matching instruction.md:15-17, integration.md:3-19 and hireops_rules.md:204-210 ('The only settings you can count on are PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH'). Live updates need no extra package: hireops_rules.md:128 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all fine'. Network is public (task.toml network_mode='public' in both phases); nothing in the brief needs the network beyond optional browser CDN assets, so every item is achievable even under the Internal Quality Checks sheet's stricter 'seed + runtime with no network' annotation (recorded as a workbook wording difference; the skill delivery profile says network is public). SEED. Every seeded fact the criteria rely on exists in environment/assets/seed_data.json (byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json): Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist(pos 1), Ade Bello(2), Marco Rossi(3); Screen Priya Nair(1), Samuel Ortiz(2) (functional prompt Z, hro_restart); APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; APP-101 has 120 messages with unique ascending created_at (long thread; thread_page_size=30, rules:150-153); Lena APP-301 has 3 messages and reads USR-CAN3 read_count=2 with the third message by USR-REC3, giving exactly 1 unread (Z / hro_unread_counts); Noor Platform Engineer INTERVIEW/Infrastructure -> 'Interviewing', Noor Product Designer APPLIED/Design -> 'Application received', Tomas Data Analyst SCREEN/Finance Systems -> 'In review' (hro_candidate_view); candidate_status_labels equal rules:190-197; all 10 accounts in instruction.md:19 and app_context.md exist with the stated roles; Bill Okafor manages Data Analyst. Read-marker semantics are stated (rules:215-216). GOLDEN ACHIEVABILITY. raw-evidence-index.json: all 8 artifact hashes re-verified and every matching_source_files hash equals the frozen task bytes; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records 26 scripted golden groups passed (stale refusal naming who, roles 401/403/404, bulk all-or-none, undo semantics, paging, unread/seen, drafts, live board 810 ms, restart). This is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score. UNAMBIGUITY - every graded demand traced to a public sentence (Colderwater lesson 1 checked against every functional, polish and visual criterion; no hidden requirement found): one-stage moves and skip refusal (rules:48-49); reason required and Hired not rejectable (rules:49-50); reopen only to rejected-from stage and clears reason (rules:50-51); arrival at bottom (rules:57-58); re-order with ordinary controls, persisted (rules:58-60); Interview cap incl. bulk and undo (rules:64-66, 94-95, 101-102); hiring-manager scope incl. re-order and reopen limits (rules:71-74); per-card version, 409 and 'by whom' (rules:78-82; instruction:3); optimistic move put back with reason and focus on the card (rules:86-88); bulk board order 'by stage in the order listed above, then by place' (rules:93-94); undo single-use, own-only, latest-only, blocked by move/re-order/reject/reopen by anyone or overfill, not by notes (rules:99-104); Activity content, newest first, per-job filter, no line for refusals (rules:114-118); 15 s live updates preserving typing, focus, open card and scroll (rules:122-128; instruction:5); plain text, Enter/Shift+Enter, emptied focused box, failed send kept and explained (rules:144-146); 30-message paging with remaining count and anchored place (rules:150-153); per-person unread and scrolled-up notice (rules:157-166); seen rules incl. observer exclusion (rules:170-172); reply drafts per user and conversation surviving switch, reload and ended session, hidden from other users on that browser (rules:176-181; instruction:7); note drafts kept for the user on that browser (rules:110); candidate wording and privacy, and 401/403/404 (rules:22-24, 185-202); email validity, case-insensitive duplicate, error at field, typed input kept (rules:33-36); places integer 1-50 and manager must be a hiring-manager account (rules:28-30). Lesson 13 checked: prompts use only http://localhost:3000. SECOND READINGS examined, none producing a defect: (a) Are reject/reopen undoable 'moves' (undo legs of hro_reject_reason and hro_reopen)? Rejection and reopening sit under '### Moving a card' (rules:46-53) and undo 'gives back a rejection reason the move removed' (rules:100), which only makes sense if a reopening is an undoable move; the list 'moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened' (rules:101) enumerates conflict kinds rather than redefining 'move'. One reasonable reading; at most a P3 wording opportunity (e.g. 'including a rejection or reopening'). (b) Is a re-order a 'move' that replaces the undo target? No protocol depends on it (M, L, B(3)->(4), B(12) never have Rafael re-order immediately before an undo), so both readings score the same. (c) Gate 'Reload: you are still signed in' (gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared): not stated in those exact words, but instruction:7 and rules:177-179 list reload separately from being signed out and instruction:13 asks the builder to reload and make sure nothing breaks; ordinary session semantics. (d) hro_pol_live_thread requires the new message to be shown while at the newest vs rules:126-127 'leaves alone ... how far I've scrolled': the specific rule rules:164 'if I'm at the newest message, it's shown' governs; consistent. (e) Default unread for a user with no seeded read marker is unstated, but no criterion grades an absolute count that depends on it (Lena has a marker; Rafael's counts are deltas; Mei's count is on a conversation she wrote in, and rules:159 says sending counts as reading). (f) Stale-move design: rules:78-81 require a per-card version and refusal of moves from a board that has not caught up, so a version-carrying move request is the stated design and protocol C's exact replay is fair. (g) 'source/email wherever the app shows card details' (hro_add_candidate) and the judge's choice of invalid email: minor latitude conditional on what the app shows, not a competing reading of the brief. (h) Prompt M's parenthetical 'with no reason' after undoing a rejection is not in hro_reject_reason's fail list, so the unstated detail is not graded. COUNTERFACTUALS. Broken app that could pass this row's concern: none found; every graded behaviour is publicly stated. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app relying only on the native HTML5 email bubble might have its at-field refusal missed by a DOM-reading judge; that is judge feasibility (other rows), not an instruction ambiguity. UNMEASURED. No full configured judge run or Oracle score exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope says so); that gap belongs to the runtime-evidence rows and does not create an ambiguity or unreachable item for row 6.
